message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on word search puzzle books. Puzzle books are classified in heading 4903 (children's picture, drawing or coloring books) or 4901 (printed books, brochures). CBP has generally classified crossword and word search books in 4901.99.00. The statistical suffix for "other" books under 4901.99 is: 4901.99.0050 for "Other: Other: Other" (4901.99.0050 is "Other" under the "Other" subheading). The HTS structure for 4901.99.00 is: 4901.99.00 Other; 4901.99.0030 Hardbound textbooks; 4901.99.0040 Textbooks other than hardbound; 4901.99.0050 Other hardbound books; 4901.99.0060 Other: Other (mass market paperbacks, etc.); 4901.99.0070 Other, I'm not certain of the numbering. Under 4901.99.00: 0030 Textbooks, 0045 Bibles/testaments etc.? The actual list is: 4901.99.0020 Dictionaries; 0030 Textbooks; 0040 Bibles; 0050 Hardbound books other; 0060 Other. Word search paperback would be 4901.99.0092 ("Other: Other: Other: Other"). I recall 4901.99.0092 is real, though it covers "Other" under the "Other" group. CBP rulings on puzzle books cite 4901.99.0092 (e.g., for crossword puzzle books). I'll go with that.

{"hts_code": "4901.99.0092", "reason": "A 304-page paperback word search puzzle book is a printed book not in single sheets, falling in heading 4901 as an 'other' book under subheading 4901.99."}
